Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations support prices despite recent pullback.

Silver.note: Strong solar panel demand and monetary easing provide upside potential after a deep correction.

Copper.note: Tight mine supply and structural electrification demand offset near-term macro softness.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear build-out support a bullish outlook.

Lithium.note: Persistent supply surplus and moderating EV demand growth keep prices under pressure.

Nickel.note: Massive supply growth from Indonesia continues to outpace demand, pressuring prices.

Zinc.note: Treatment charge declines and smelter curtailments indicate a tightening concentrate market.

Iron Ore.note: Ongoing weakness in China's property sector limits upside despite steady Australian supply.

Coal.note: High global inventories and long-term thermal demand destruction cap upside potential.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks and steady EV motor demand provide a slight premium.

Manganese.note: Sluggish global steel production and adequate supply keep the outlook slightly subdued.

PGM.note: Long-term EV transition headwinds offset by South African supply constraints.

Potash.note: Balanced global supply and steady agricultural demand result in a neutral price outlook.

Aluminum.note: Tight primary supply growth and strong lightweighting demand in autos support prices.

Diversified.note: Balanced portfolio exposure to copper and iron ore provides stable, slightly positive equity returns.
